versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Physiology-PMPH-10edition skill collection, based on the 10th edition of PMPH Physiology.

- Includes 165 systematically organized physiology skills covering neural, sensory, endocrine, metabolic, cardiovascular, and respiratory systems.
- Provides bilingual (Chinese/English) skill names, descriptions, and use cases for each item.
- Designed for clinical and educational reference, supporting competency-based learning and assessment.
- Licensed under MIT.
